title: pteridium aquilinum subsp. pinetorum
intro: Pteridium aquilinum subsp. pinetorum, commonly known as the bristly brake fern, is a subspecies of the bracken fern that is native to the mountainous regions of the world. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The health benefits of Pteridium aquilinum subsp. pinetorum include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
